score_columns.description: Distance-to-TSS metadata score, closer variants ranked higher.

candidate_sources.name: TraitGym complex_traits
blocking_reasons: Variant labels are public and load through Hugging Face datasets, but the source does not provide a GenoLeWM-FX ref/alt teacher-delta cache.
The loaded columns expose variant metadata and binary labels, not signed teacher residuals or teacher feature tensors.

candidate_sources.name: TraitGym mendelian_traits
blocking_reasons: The public split is below the 10k cheap-probe floor.
The source does not provide ref/alt teacher deltas or teacher feature tensors.

candidate_sources.name: MAVE, MPRA, and QTL candidate slices
blocking_reasons: No exact assay, genome build, windowing rule, split manifest, and teacher-cache manifest is locked in this repo.
Using these sources now would require new curation before the probe can be reproduced.

candidate_teachers.name: AlphaGenome API
blocking_reasons: The contract permits AlphaGenome only as a bounded sampled calibration/API baseline unless terms and rates support larger use.
The local run has no AlphaGenome API key or package, and the public API is not a checksum-addressed 10k-50k teacher cache.

candidate_teachers.name: AlphaGenome released weights
candidate_teachers.role_allowed_by_contract: future heavyweight local teacher if terms, hardware, and artifacts are locked
blocking_reasons: Weights require accepting model terms and the upstream docs recommend H100-class hardware for model inference.
No accepted-terms receipt, model revision, hardware receipt, or ref/alt teacher-cache artifact is available in this repo.

candidate_teachers.name: Borzoi
blocking_reasons: The model is public, but the local run does not have the TensorFlow teacher stack or downloaded model weights.
The upstream large training data is requester-pays; no compact public ref/alt cache is locked for GenoLeWM-FX.

candidate_teachers.name: Enformer
blocking_reasons: No TensorFlow teacher stack, model revision, input window manifest, or ref/alt output cache is present in this repo.
Using Enformer now would make the probe depend on ad hoc setup rather than a public GenoLeWM-FX cache manifest.

candidate_teachers.name: ChromBPNet
blocking_reasons: The repository provides model/training tooling, but no selected cell-type model, peaks, genome, or ref/alt cache is locked here.
No GPU/Docker teacher runtime receipt or checksum-addressed GenoLeWM-FX cache is present.

required_baselines: available public model predictions when feasible

recommended_issue_actions.reason: The source-controlled contract is locked in docs/research/fx-experiment-contract.md.
The feasibility gate found no reproducible 10k-50k public teacher-delta slice under the contract.
Teacher adapters and caches should not be built until a source/teacher pair passes the feasibility gate.
The residual model path should not be implemented without a selected target and teacher cache.
No staged Hugging Face jobs should launch without the #259 go decision.
The locked benchmark gate is unreachable because the experiment stops at feasibility.
The public output is the kill report, not a model artifact release.
The final paper/demo decision is no FX paper update and no demo because evidence is insufficient.
